title: Temporary Rate Reduction Plan Installment and Plan Rate
content:
**Clause.** The Temporary Rate Reduction Plan installment of the Hardship Assistance Programs is the level installment that repays the loan's unpaid principal at the program's plan rate over the due dates left from the loan's next due date through its maturity date, counted as the whole calendar months from the next due date to the maturity date plus one and counting at least one due date. The Temporary Rate Reduction Plan installment is rounded to the cent once, on the final figure, and is never set below the program's minimum plan installment. Because the installment is never set below the program's minimum plan installment, it never works out to 0.00. The plan rate offered and recorded is the rate the installment is worked at.

Where another rule of this policy replaces the program's plan rate or the level installment, the replacement takes its place; every point that applies is then subtracted from the plan rate, never taking it below 1.99 percent, and the installment is worked once, at the rate so reached.

## Terms of the clause

- *Unpaid principal, next due date, maturity date*: as the loan's Personal Loans record shows them on the decision date.
- *Plan rate, minimum plan installment*: the Temporary Rate Reduction Plan figures in the program's payment and rate terms schedule.
- *Level installment*: the equal monthly amount that repays the unpaid principal with interest at the plan rate taken monthly (one-twelfth of the annual percentage per month) over the due dates left.
- *Floor*: the plan rate is never below 1.99 percent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: a plan rate of 6.00 percent and a minimum of 30.00 USD)

| Unpaid principal | Due dates left | Level installment before rounding | Installment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12,000.00 USD | 24 | 531.847… | 531.85 USD |
| 300.00 USD | 24 | 13.296… | 30.00 USD (the minimum) |

Next due date 15 April and maturity date 15 March of the following year give 11 whole months plus one: 12 due dates left.
